'''''Carex divulsa''''', the '''grey sedge''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Carex]]'', native to Macaronesia, Europe, northwest Africa, the Caucasus region, and the Middle East as far east as Turkmenistan.<ref name="299519-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:299519-1 |title=''Carex divulsa'' Stokes |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=7 January 2021 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=''Carex divulsa'' grey sedge |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/128685/Carex-divulsa/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=7 January 2021 }}</ref> It has been introduced to northeast Argentina, the District of Columbia and Pennsylvania in the United States, Ontario in Canada, the North Island of New Zealand, and Tasmania and Victoria in Australia.<ref name="299519-1" /> It is the namesake of the ''Carex divulsa'' [[Species complex|aggregate]].<ref name="1_of_1780_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=Taxonomy and new taxa of the ''Carex divulsa'' aggregate in Eurasia (Section Phaestoglochin, Cyperaceae) |year=2008 |last1=Molina |first1=ANA |last2=Acedo |first2=Carmen |last3=Llamas |first3=Félix |journal=Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society |volume=156 |issue=3 |pages=385–409 |doi=10.1111/j.1095-8339.2007.00760.x |doi-access=free }}</ref>
